declaration_verdict.note: stated (OK); relation different formulation; the auditor's reading: For every d : Direction, any parameter type P, any a : P -> Frequency -> C and S : Set P, if a p = 0 for every p not in S then directionalInverse d (a p) x = 0 for every such p and every x. Docstring: 'Inversion uses only the torus variable and preserves support in every external parameter.' This is

snippet.text:
theorem inverse_preserves_parameter_support {P : Type*} (d : Direction)
    (a : P → Frequency → ℂ) (S : Set P)
    (hsupport : ∀ p, p ∉ S → ∀ k, a p k = 0) :
    ∀ p, p ∉ S → ∀ x, directionalInverse d (a p) x = 0
